metadata.window_title: UI Smoke - SPV UI Surface Probe

text.String: Procedural UI surface, emitted as SPIR-V
This smoke is the shortest path from Kain UI authoring to a shader-side surface concept. It is intentionally compute-driven today, not a finished fullscreen-quad renderer.
Host next: fullscreen quad, pointer uniforms, interaction data, font atlas uploads.
Client now: rounded-rect SDF-like canvas math authored in Kain and emitted through the GPU artifact pipeline.
Text still needs a font atlas plus glyph layout buffers.
A true retained UI loop still belongs on the host side until the shader and runtime contract grows stronger data exchange.
